component_checklist.assertion: On first open the register dialog shows one vertical form, one required combobox, two textboxes, and one small ghost collapse. There is no spinbutton, no unit, no checkbox, and no alert. Source is empty and its placeholder is the localized select-a-repository sentence. Source ID is an empty required textbox of type text. Its placeholder is Qwen/Qwen3-8B and it has no maximum length. Name is an empty textbox of type text, is not marked required, has no maximum length, and its placeholder is the localized optional display name. The collapse header is the localized advanced-options sentence, aria-expanded is false, and revision is not visible. Directory URL, model directory, node, model ID, and parse are absent. After ModelScope is selected the combobox text is ModelScope, and source ID, name, and the collapsed revision stay unchanged. The create POST to /api/v1/models sends source modelscope, the fixture repository, revision main, and the typed name, and the response is 201. The independent GET before metadata recovery stores source modelscope, the fixture repository, revision master, the typed name, an empty architecture, and weight 0, and it omits context length, precision, and readme, with no node copy and no storage copy. After recovery the independent GET stores the same identity with architecture Qwen2ForCausalLM, precision float16, context length 4096, the fixture readme, and the fixture weight.
Not fully exercised: **首次打开**：默认值正确；编辑时回填已保存值；异步加载结束前不能提交不完整数据；secret 不回显。
Not fully exercised: **必填校验**：每个必填字段分别输入空字符串和纯空白，错误定位到该字段，且没有 mutation 请求。
Not fully exercised: **字段边界**：按后续组件清单逐字段执行最小、最大、越界、非法格式等适用场景；不虚构产品没有的上限。
Not fully exercised: **枚举穷举**：每个实际可选项单独选择，验证选中态、精确提交值、保存回读及适用运行时效果。
Not fully exercised: **条件字段**：切换控制项，验证显隐、首次默认值、隐藏值的提交规则、重新显示后的保留或重置规则。

The register dialog has one visible mask. The minimal registration fills only the source and the repository id. That POST omits the name and carries an empty revision. The response is 201. The reloaded detail shows the repository id, the fixture commit, Qwen2ForCausalLM, float16, and context length 4,096. The model list contains that one model. After a page reload the list still contains that one model. The independent GET stores the repository id as the name and stores that commit.

The advanced section icon sits at the start of the header. The complete registration fills both optional fields, the display name and the revision. That POST carries the typed name and revision master. The independent GET stores that typed name and revision master. After that model is deleted, a second registration clears the display name and leaves the revision empty. That POST omits the name and carries an empty revision. The independent GET stores the repository id as the name and stores the fixture commit.
While the metadata refresh POST is held the refresh button stays loading and a second click sends no further refresh. The independent GET keeps the same model row

The register failure uses the error notice. A 257-character name is rejected with 400 FIELD_INVALID on the name field. The dialog stays open and keeps the repository id, revision main, and that name. The notice shows the registration-failed prefix and the 256-character limit. The model list stays empty. Replacing the name and submitting again returns 201, and the independent GET stores the corrected name and revision master.
Cancel, the close button and Escape each close the register dialog immediately, with no unsaved-changes prompt and no registration write. The independent model list GET stays unchanged

covered: notices are tied to the persisted result rather than to their own appearance. A rejected name returns real 400 FIELD_INVALID / params.field=name, and the case asserts the translated error notice carries that cause, that the dialog keeps every field, and that the server-side model list is still empty. A source outage produces one notice whose code and params are compared exactly (MODEL_METADATA_UNREACHABLE with the real host), the row is saved with metadata unknown rather than invented, and the exact set of 503 source reads behind that notice is enumerated from the fixture audit - so the notice is matched against what actually happened upstream. Success is only claimed after listed()/read() agree with the created row.
